sourceFindings: 2022 requires one of four writing responses; the paper total is 315 (120+40+50+60+45). Scheme PDF page 15 describes a separate 45-mark adjustment using an examiner spreadsheet. That is not an extra task or a second writing response.
Listening 1(b): Páirt i scannáin mhóra earns 7; Páirt i Ros na Rún earns 5. Listening 5(b): 28 Celsius earns 8; 22 Celsius earns 6. Preserve permitted scores [0,5,7] and [0,6,8].
The poem is Seán is a Chaitín Bán by Peadar Ó hAnnracháin. Keep all five stanzas; the answer to 3C(5) can be ar fán or i measc cat na gcomharsan.

4A is the sports-day notice, Kellie Harrington and a new sports hall. Layout 1, pictures 10/13/5/5 and shared Gaeilge 11. The SEC gives partial credit for peil and cluiche peile, date/currency deductions and name-only guest deduction; preserve page 9 guidance.

4B is a concert letter to an aunt or uncle in America. Expand the two recipient routes. The four picture instructions each require two open information points (4+3), with layout 6 and shared Gaeilge 11. No length deduction is published for this letter.
2022 language bands differ from 2023+: Sármhaith 9–11, An-mhaith 7–8, Maith 5–6, Lag 2–4, An-lag 1, Easnamhach 0.
5A is Saoire Cois Farraige; 5B is a dumping incident. Both require about 90 words, communication 34 and shared Gaeilge 11, length deductions 80–90:0,60–79:-2,30–59:-3,<30:-4.

The 5B scheme conflicts internally: its main bullet deducts 4 per missing reference and lists caps 34,30,26,22,18, but a later line says Pionós -5. Both 5A/5B also show Tagairt /-12. Preserve the published text and explain the conflict; no invented automatic reference deduction.
Scheme examples are open content possibilities, not printed selection menus. Audio transcripts on PDF pages 17–19 remain answer material.
